summary: Verified WorkMate AI multi-tenant SaaS conversion end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_workspace.py (22 tests, all pass) covering: register-creates-workspace-and-owner (+409 on duplicate email), role migration (admin@technova->owner, sarah/khalid->manager, ahmed/nora->employee), TWO independent workspaces isolation (each owner sees only own /tasks + /team, cross-workspace DELETE task -> 404), invitations create/list/duplicate-conflict/existing-member-conflict/lookup/accept/2nd-use-400, resend bumps expires_at + cancel + resend-on-cancelled 400, RBAC (employee 403 on invite/team-delete/role-change, manager 403 on invite + role-change per spec, owner CAN change role), team stats shape (int fields), team cross-workspace delete -> 404, regression on auth/me carrying workspace_name, tasks CRUD, /tasks/analytics, /memory, /me/stats, /stats, /settings, /employees, /documents, /feedback. Full backend suite: 88 passed / 5 pre-existing legacy failures in test_auth_session.py + test_webhooks_prod.py caused by role migration (they hard-assert role=='admin'/'employee' but admin@technova is now 'owner' and sarah/khalid are 'manager'). These legacy tests should be updated by the main agent; the behavior itself is CORRECT per spec. Frontend: login /login shows create-workspace-link that navigates to /register; register form creates workspace + lands on /admin with sidebar-workspace-name showing the new name; admin@technova login lands on /admin with sidebar workspace 'TechNova'; nav-team opens team-tab with 9 members incl Owner badge (admin), Manager badges (sarah + khalid), Employee badges (others), workload bars + tasks counts; invite-form + send-invite creates invitation, shows last-invite-banner with accept-invite URL + copy-invite-link-btn, pending row has copy/resend/cancel buttons all working (resend fires 'Invitation refreshed' toast); /accept-invite/{token} renders accept-invite-card with 'You've been invited to TechNova', role 'Employee', 'invited by Admin', prefilled email; submitting invite-name-input + invite-password-input successfully creates the user, shows 'Welcome to TechNova' toast, and lands on /chat with employee-chat rendered. All 8 admin sidebar tabs present.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1396 lines — exceeds the 700-line threshold significantly. Recommend splitting into routers: auth.py (login/register/accept-invite/me), invitations.py, team.py, tasks.py, chat.py, admin.py, webhooks.py. This will become critical for maintainability as more SaaS features are added.

AdminDashboard.jsx is 1346 lines and now contains TeamTab in addition to Dashboard/Tasks/Knowledge/Employees/Settings/Automations/Feedback. Split into /pages/admin/*.jsx modules (Team.jsx, Tasks.jsx, etc.) with a shared layout wrapper.

The 5 stale legacy tests (test_auth_session.py / test_webhooks_prod.py) hardcode the pre-migration roles and MUST be updated by main agent — they will keep failing until aligned with the new role enum. Suggested fix: change 'admin' -> 'owner' for admin@technova and 'employee' -> 'manager' for sarah@technova across those files.

PATCH /api/team/{id}/role currently only owner may change roles (require_owner). This matches spec but note that admins CANNOT promote/demote members — if that changes later, migrate to require_admin with an extra 'target != owner' guard.

invite acceptance path uses inv['email'] verbatim (case already lowered at creation), and creates a new user; if a user with that email exists in ANOTHER workspace, /auth/accept-invite returns 409 (unique-email semantics across the entire platform). This may be intentional but is worth documenting as a global uniqueness constraint.
GET /api/team iterates a per-user db.tasks.find inside a Python loop (N+1). Fine for <200 members; consider $group aggregation for scale.
N8N webhook endpoints hardcode 'Ahmed Ali' as employee — legacy placeholder that should probably use the caller's user.name when time permits.
invite tokens are two concatenated uuid4.hex (64 chars) — enough entropy but not cryptographically signed. Consider secrets.token_urlsafe(48) for the future.
server.py hardcodes N8N_LEAVE_WEBHOOK + N8N_IT_SUPPORT_WEBHOOK URLs. Move to env vars.

extract_memory_background is a fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task inside a StreamingResponse generator — as noted in iteration_4, task may be cancelled if client disconnects mid-stream. Working today but fragile. FastAPI BackgroundTasks or an outbound queue would be more durable.
